Sandbox_MedicalCustomHealthcareItems_too: Allows TDDUP custom medical supplies in treatment and custom loot injection. Vanilla supplies and clean water remain available where supported.
Sandbox_MedicalDownedMechanic_tooltip: Allows near-fatal injuries or five open non-fatal substantial injuries to put the spouse into the recoverable DOWNED state.
Sandbox_MedicalInjurySystem_tooltip: Records evidence-based spouse injuries and enables the custom medical ledger. Turning this off stops new custom injuries; existing ledger data is preserved.
Sandbox_MedicalNonCombatConditions_toolt: Observes evidence-backed non-combat health conditions. No random conditions.
